alternatives.name: Mutate existing r10 pointer and builder in place
alternatives.reason: Their paths are r10 members; modifying them destroys current-file agreement with historical r10 and creates unapproved member deltas.

alternatives.name: Copy the 20-row draft to a formal r11 file
alternatives.reason: The draft still hashes the r10 pointer and builder; current resolver selects r10 and r11 is not executable.

alternatives.name: Versioned r11 pointer and builder plus explicit resolver switch
alternatives.reason: Preserves r10 artifacts byte-for-byte, provides a strict r11 build DAG and 20-member r11 inventory, but requires controlled additional infrastructure-member changes.

proposed_sequence_not_executed: Record immutable r10 manifest and old pointer raw hashes; verify the approved scanner repair and all future infrastructure changes before building.
Add an independent r11 identity-pointer artifact with revision r11 and exact future r11 freeze path; omit a freeze-file SHA to avoid a hash cycle.
Add an r11-specific builder based on the r10 mechanism: parent is immutable r10, output is a new exclusive-create r11 path, member count exactly 20; no r10 file is overwritten.
Update the current identity resolver to select only the explicitly pinned r11 pointer and fail closed on missing/malformed state; do not auto-discover or silently fall back to r10.

Use 20 r11 member rows: 16 unchanged r10 paths, the approved scanner path with new SHA, the resolver path with reviewed new SHA, and r11-specific builder and pointer paths replacing the old two paths.
Finalize builder and resolver bytes first, then pointer bytes, then hash all actual member bytes and construct r11 manifest. Verify raw manifest SHA independently; never reuse the draft SHA.

Only after separate freeze acceptance and authorization approval, resolve old invoked r10 authorization under the frozen lifecycle contract, issue fresh authorization/attempt/namespace bindings to exact r11 path and raw SHA, and require a fresh non-consuming Mac-local preflight before any execution.
hash_dependency_dag: finalized builder/resolver/other member bytes -> member SHA-256 list
versioned r11 pointer containing revision and freeze path but not freeze SHA -> pointer SHA-256 member
member list + frozen evaluation identities + parent r10 SHA -> r11 manifest bytes -> raw r11 SHA-256
raw r11 SHA-256 -> future authorization manifest -> authorization SHA-256 -> future preflight artifact -> explicit preflight SHA-256 -> formal consumer
scope_exception_required: The current 'only scanner member differs from r10' condition cannot coexist with an executable r11 under the existing single-pointer resolver. Separate approval is required for resolver content change and r11 builder/pointer member substitutions; these must be proven infrastructure-only.
authorization_binding: Future issuer must resolve and verify r11, pin revision/path/raw manifest SHA, existing frozen evaluation hashes, fresh authorization/attempt/derived physical namespace IDs; current adapter/formal/preflight guards must all compare against the same current r11 identity. Old r10 authorization and preflight are never transplanted.
historical_preservation: Never rewrite r10 manifest, old r10 pointer artifact, historical authorization/lifecycle ledger, transaction journal, preflight, attempt or provenance artifacts. Preserve raw hashes and append-only lineage.
